note: Both sets extract only the five legend labels of Figure 2-11 as 'structural property center' claims, which are vague and carry no values or span conditions. Set B adds one extra claim, axial stiffness = 1e10 N at r/R = 1.0, but 1e10 is only the y-axis multiplier and the curve at r/R = 1.0 is near zero, so the claim misreads the plot and its quote (a splice of axis labels) does not support it. Set A therefore has no wrong claims while Set B has one, making A the better set.
remarks: Neither set captures any quantitative data from Figure 2-10 (mass density, edgewise/flapwise/torsional stiffness, axial stiffness vs r/R) or the chordwise offset values in Figure 2-11; only legend labels were extracted. The 'structural property center' attribute is generic — the underlying quantity is chordwise offset [m] of each center versus blade span r/R. Set B's axial-stiffness claim appears to bind the axis scale factor (1e10) as a data value at the wrong span location.
